title: ChatBounty
tagline: Helping people gather, one bounty at a time. Decentralized, organic, fun.
description: The project combines the exciting world of Web 3 and the increasing gap between the desire and ability to gather in person. By empowering people to issue bounties to meet up, ChatBounty helps connect people and foster longlasting relationships beyond online interactions, in a decentralized manner.
how_its_made: The project uses React as the frontend to support a natively cross-platform experience, with a web-based interface that exempts the users from dealing with app downloads. The backend is built with the Hardhats framework to provide efficient and performant Flow contract creation and verification.
